mapper.sql: FROM code a JOIN codegroup b ON b.seq = a.codegroup_seq WHERE 1=1 AND a.delNy = 0
mapper.select:
select aa.* from( SELECT a.seq, a.delNy, a.codegroupcode, b.name, a.code, a.codename, a.number, a.codegroup_seq
ORDER BY a.seq DESC ) aa limit #{rowNumToShow} offset #{startRnumForMysql}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code( delNy, codegroupcode, code, codename, number, codegroup_seq )VALUES( 0, #{codegroupcode}, #{code}, #{codename}, #{number}, #{seq} )
mapper.select: SELECT seq, delNy, codegroupcode, name, code, codename, number, codegroup_seq FROM code WHERE 1=1 AND delNy = 0
